Sherry FitzGerald Reilly is delighted to present No. 1 Dean Cogan Place, a property ideally positioned in the heart of Navan town. This superb location offers an exceptional level of convenience, with the extensive range of amenities that Navan has to offer quite literally on the doorstep.

The property enjoys a particularly desirable position within easy walking distance of Navan town centre, meaning residents can enjoy the convenience of having shops, cafés, restaurants, bars and a wide range of everyday services all close at hand. Navan Shopping Centre, the town's main shopping streets and a host of supermarkets and local businesses are all within easy reach, making this an ideal location for those looking to have everything they need close by.

The location is also well suited to families, with a selection of primary and secondary schools, childcare facilities and sporting clubs available throughout the town. Navan offers excellent recreational amenities including Aura Leisure Centre, Navan Racecourse and a wide variety of GAA, soccer, rugby and other sporting facilities. The nearby Boyne River and surrounding Boyne Valley also provide excellent opportunities for walking, running and enjoying the outdoors.

For commuters, the property is ideally placed for access to the M3 motorway, providing a direct route towards Dublin and the M50. Regular bus services operate from Navan, offering convenient connections to Dublin and surrounding towns, while Drogheda, Trim, Slane and Kells are all within easy reach by road.

A particularly attractive feature of the property is the spacious and private rear garden. Offering a generous outdoor area in such a central town location, the garden provides excellent scope for outdoor entertaining, family activities or simply enjoying a private space away from the hustle and bustle of town life. The combination of a substantial rear garden and an exceptionally convenient town-centre setting is becoming increasingly difficult to find.

With virtually every amenity required for modern day living within walking distance, No. 1 Dean Cogan Place represents an excellent opportunity to acquire a home in one of Navan's most convenient and established locations.
